cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10...3.31)

project(libgodot-sample VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

set(LIBGODOT_INCLUDE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory containing core/extension/libgodot.h")

add_subdirectory(godot-cpp)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} main.cpp)

# libgodot.h includes "core/extension/gdextension_interface.gen.h"; forward
# that to the identical interface header generated by godot-cpp so the types
# are only defined once.
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shim/core/extension/gdextension_interface.gen.h
    "#pragma once\n#include <gdextension_interface.h>\n")
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shim
    ${LIBGODOT_INCLUDE_DIR}/core/extension)
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE godot::cpp godot)

install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} DESTINATION bin)
